label: Platforma e-Zamówienia
terms_note: Polish public procurement; API for integrators via subscription; offers submitted in the platform with a qualified signature.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (integrator API behind a WSO2 portal). Lane `assist` → **keep**. Confidence medium.
auth: 1. Register on the API portal → subscribe → key.
reference.limits: - Offers need a qualified e-signature inside the platform. - Polish public procurement; API for integrators via subscription; offers submitted in the platform with a qualified signature.

adapter.rate_note: https://ezamowienia.gov.pl/pl/integracja/ (opened 2026-09-25): reading BZP notices 'nie wymaga przejścia procedury integracyjnej' (no integration procedure, no key); no rate limit is published. Two requests per second.
adapter.terms: API use is governed by the 'Regulamin korzystania z API' (https://media.ezamowienia.gov.pl/pod/2023/01/Regulamin-korzystania-z-API.pdf). Offers are submitted inside the e-Zamówienia platform with a qualified electronic signature.

search_postings.note: GET /mo-board/api/v1/notice (API BZP WebService, 'Notices Board API' bzp.external.API.yaml in Załącznik 3). NoticeType, PublicationDateFrom/To and PageSize are required by the API: the window is fixed to contract notices (NoticeType=ContractNotice, 'ogłoszenie o zamówieniu') published from the 1st of the current month (UTC) until now. `query` → OrderObject (subject of the contract, Polish text match), `category` → CpvCode (e.g. 34121400-5). Results come OLDEST FIRST within the window and the API pages with a SearchAfter cursor that this adapter does not follow, so only the first `limit` (≤ 100) matches are returned and page is ignored — narrow with query/category. min_budget is not sent (no value filter). id is the notice number (e.g. 2026/BZP 00415198/01); deadline = submittingOffersDate; the full notice is in raw.htmlBody, the notice page is https://ezamowienia.gov.pl/mo-client-board/bzp/notice-details/id/<raw.objectId>. Throttling: calls a second or two apart are answered 403 'Dostęp zablokowany / Access Blocked' (an HTML WAF page) for a while; calls 5 s apart pass, so the client-side limit is one call per 5 s (live check 2026-09-26).

get_posting.note: GET /mo-board/api/v1/notice?NoticeNumber=<id> over the whole platform period (2021-01-01 → now; the required date window). Only contract notices (NoticeType=ContractNotice) are looked up; a number of another notice type or an unknown number returns no record (invalid_input).

not_offered.me: Reading BZP needs no account; the authenticated APIs (MT, MO, PP) are for integrated buyer systems after integration tests.
not_offered.submit_bid: No offer API: offers are prepared and signed with a qualified e-signature inside the platform; the published APIs (BZP, MT, MO, PP, MMiA, CRD) cover notices, plans, reports and OCDS events.
not_offered.list_messages: Correspondence with the buyer happens inside the platform; no messaging API is published.
not_offered.send_message: Correspondence with the buyer happens inside the platform; no messaging API is published.
not_offered.credits: The platform is free; no account or credit endpoint.

live_check.notes: fixed: a WAF answers 403 'Dostęp zablokowany / Access Blocked' to calls 1-2 s apart (TypeScript half of the parity run was blocked); client-side limit now one call per 5 s; all read tools answered, schema-valid
